paragraphs.text: Unified DSH workspaces for Claude Code, Codex and OMP, with local and SSH conversations, tool approv
als and persistent history.
# DSH Remote Agents
Unified DSH workspaces for **Claude Code, Codex and OMP**, with local and SSH conversations, tool ap
provals and persistent history. Native DSH sessions share the same sidebar and retain their original
conversation interface.
Unofficial community plugin, independently developed and maintained; not affiliated with DeepSeek. U
ser messages and provider output are never translated or rewritten.
> **0.5.0 moves the backend to Rust.** Every backend operation now runs in a bundled Rust sidecar wh
ile the DSH interface and state files stay the same. Install `dsh-remote-agents@latest`, or `dsh-rem
ote-agents@0.4.1` for the previous, frozen JavaScript release preserved on the `legacy-js` branch. S
ee native architecture and builds.
## What's new in 0.5.0
- **The backend is now a Rust sidecar.** Session and fleet storage, CLI discovery and configuration,
SSH/tmux terminals, provider events, approvals, imports, search/export and original OMP history run
in a bundled executable that speaks bounded JSONL on stdio. Only the Host shim and the Claude SDK h
elper stay in JavaScript. Existing state files keep their format, so upgrading from 0.4.1 preserves

conversations, workspaces and machines.
- **Conversation commands**: `/help`, `/status`, `/model`, `
/effort`, `/permissions`, `/rename`, `/pin`, `/archive`, `/new`, `/stop` and `/export` with keyboard

completion, executed by the backend and never sent to the model.
- **Per-conversation Models tab**
for OMP roles, presets, provider connections and custom models, scoped to that conversation's machin

e and workspace.
- **Complete tool archives** with 16-call paging, full-value search, UTF-8-safe rea

ds and per-turn JSONL export.
- **Automatic titles**, agent-specific conversation tabs, structured O

MP task phases and OMP semantic color accents.
- **SSH destinations** (`alias`, `user@host`, `host:p
ort`, `ssh://…`) are tested before saving, with per-machine connection results and safe rename/remov

al.
- macOS (arm64/x64) and Linux (arm64/x64, static musl) executables ship in the package; npm publ
ishes each build with a signed provenance attestation.
## What's new in 0.4.1 (legacy JavaScript)
- Fix an OMP conversation black screen caused by phased `todo` records (`op/list` input and `details

.phases` output).
- Show normalized OMP tasks and their current statuses, including result-only upda

tes and empty lists. Unknown/truncated todo formats fall back to structured data.
- Isolate tool-car
d rendering failures so one bad card cannot remove the conversation, composer or stop control. Exist
ing affected history can be reopened without deleting it.
### Conversation capabilities
- Under each **Workspace**, use the compact **new-session icon → DSH / Claude Code / Codex / OMP**.
The session inherits that workspace's directory and opens immediately; no separate Session Workbench

or second creation form.
- Agent logos distinguish sessions in the shared list and conversation hea
der. **DSH** keeps its original conversation renderer and model configuration; **Claude Code / Codex
/ OMP** use structured chat with streaming text, tool calls/results, permission decisions and inter

ruption—not terminal output disguised as chat.
- Composer model search/custom IDs, per-model reasoni
ng levels and native permission modes (including explicit YOLO), with **Follow CLI** defaults. Chang

es are session-scoped, persisted and applied on the next turn; running turns lock the controls.
- **
Add workspace → Machine → Directory** supports saved SSH hosts and new SSH destinations (tested befo
re saving), `~/` expansion, directory suggestions, Tab completion and arrow-key selection. Remote se

ssions use the selected host's CLI, models and authentication.
- Remote workspace **CLI versions & u
pdates** exposes explicit per-agent update buttons, asynchronous progress, duplicate-update protecti

on and post-update version/compatibility checks. No updates run on discovery or reconnect.
- Native
DSH semantic theme tokens, including light/dark mode, typography, compact controls and layout cleara

nces.
- Native DSH rows keep live approval/question/plan-review warnings and unread-completion marke
rs. Pending interaction takes precedence over running, and running takes precedence over completion

reminders.
- Claude Agent SDK 0.3.318 and OMP RPC v2 adapters. Unavailable/incompatible CLIs are dis

abled, with no silent terminal fallback.
- Codex 0.167.x app-server v2: streamed messages, command o
utput, file patches, live plans, one-call command/file approvals, interruption and persisted thread

continuation. Claude/Codex can copy a terminal resume command.
- Creating an external session does n
ot start a process. Its first explicit message does. Backend identity is fixed per session; native d

rafts are preserved.
[该节后续省略]
## Existing fleet features
Open **Machines & projects** for:
- Local machines and SSH destinations (alias, `user@host`, `host:port` or `ssh://user@host:port`) th
at are tested before saving, with an explicit **Save without testing** override. Destination fields
suggest the `Host` aliases of `~/.ssh/config` that are not machines yet. They are read without runni

t` aliases of `~/.ssh/config` that are not machines yet. They are read without running ssh.
[该节后续省略]
## Requirements
- DSH **0.2.x**, at least `0.2.2-rc.1` (verified on `0.2.2-rc.1`). Other DSH minor versions require

revalidation.
- Node.js 22+ on the plugin Host.
- Structured Claude: installed and authenticated Cla

ude Code ≥2.1.318 and <3.
- Structured Codex: installed and authenticated Codex CLI 0.167.x; other v

ersions require protocol revalidation.
- Structured OMP: installed and authenticated OMP ≥18.17 and

<19; source-verified protocol version is 18.17.0 with RPC v2 negotiation.
- Legacy terminals additio
nally require tmux and, for remote machines, OpenSSH. Target machines must be macOS/Linux with tmux

and the selected CLI.
- Absolute project paths on the respective host; remote tmux must be on its no
ninteractive SSH PATH.
The plugin uses owner-only exact Fetch routes on DSH's existing authenticated `/api` HTTP/IPC carrie
r. It does not start another Web server.
## Security and persistence
All operations require the DSH owner. **Tool/terminal access is not an OS sandbox** and can have the
privileges of the corresponding local/SSH account. Do not share owner access with untrusted users.
